notes.title: Patch Notes -Ver.1.02
notes.content:
Updates: 

Malus Code Ver 1.02 have a save file for Tokyo School Life that unlocks all of the content in the Extra menu, meant for those who lost their data due to the bug in Malus Code Ver 1.00.

Please read it using the following link.
http://store.steampowered.com/app/320760/
